info.name: IAA backend 0.3
info.description: Import this file in Postman with File → Import. Collection variable baseUrl is the local API. Set accessToken to an OIDC bearer token for protected routes. POST WP2 assessments saves planningToken from data.accessToken. Replace UUID variables with ids returned by the API. Example bodies are illustrative, not approved project data.

request.description: Development only. Returns the illustrative WP1-DEMO-001 draft. 404 outside development.

Creates a planning assessment. The response data.accessToken is saved into the planningToken collection variable by the test script. Follow-up calls send it as X-Planning-Token. areaId must be an existing geography UUID.
Send the file as raw bytes. Set Content-Type to the file MIME type and X-File-Name to the plain file name. Limit 5 MiB. Requires a Bearer access token.
